features: Hand Wrapped Pip Berry Decorative Garland for Home Decor and Interior Design
High-Quality material: a combination of wrapped wire and red berries, you are free to change the shape of the cuttings as needed for decoration.
Red berries: red berries are embellished on brown vines, symbolizing the good wishes of Christmas. Wreaths are a requisite for your winter holidays.

You can put it anywhere you want to create a Christmas atmosphere, or you can put it under a fireplace, window, fence, Christmas tree or anywhere else.Use as a decorative indoor accent piece for any room. Adds a touch of homey-ness to any door or entryway.
Great housewarming gift for family, friends, neighbors and acquaintances
